Per-bank missing quarters are not explicitly enumerated, but the reported counts (746 rows vs. 14×54=756 possible grid cells) make the 10 missing (CERT,REPDTE) combos inferable; endpoint comparison additionally surfaces the 2 banks (CERT 14240, 17748) that exited between 2024-06-30 and 2025-06-30.
